title: The Voter Identification (Amendment of List of Specified Documents) (Northern Ireland) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make a change to the list of the types of photographic identification that can be used by a person wishing to vote in person at a polling station at UK Parliamentary elections in Northern Ireland. The changes to the UK Parliamentary election rules also apply to elections to the Northern Ireland Assembly by virtue of article 3 of, and Schedule 1 to, the Northern Ireland Assembly (Elections) Order 2001 (S.I. 2001/2599).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Springholm, Dumfries and Galloway) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations impose restrictions of an emergency nature on flying in the area specified in the Schedule. They are intended to be of temporary duration and will be revoked as soon as the emergency in question has passed.

The South East Scotland Trunk Roads (Temporary Prohibitions of Traffic and Overtaking and Temporary Speed Restrictions) (No. 11) Order 2026
The Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft (Specified Information etc.) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations specify, for the purposes of paragraph 5 of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021, the information that a police officer may require from a person suspected of flying an unmanned aircraft.

title: The Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 5) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/1158) (“the No. 5 Regulations”).

title: The Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement for a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: The Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement of a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) Order 2025 and The Electricity (Individual Exemption from the Requirement of a Transmission Licence) (Dogger Bank A) (Amendment) Order 2025 granted an exemption to Doggerbank Offshore Wind Farm Project 1 Projco Limited from the requirement to hold an electricity transmission licence in respect of Dogger Bank A Offshore Wind Farm. Those Orders combined provided for exemption until 18th December 2026. This Order extends the duration of the exemption until 18th April 2027.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Edinburgh) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations impose restrictions on the flying of unmanned aircraft in the vicinity of Edinburgh, where the gathering of a large number of persons is due to take place for the Torchlight Parade and Hogmanay celebrations. The Civil Aviation Authority and the Department for Transport agree that it is necessary in the public interest to restrict the flying of unmanned aircraft in that area for reasons of public safety and security.

title: The Cambourne to Cambridge Order 2026
summary: This Order authorises Cambridgeshire County Council to construct and operate a new guided busway system between Sterling Way in Cambourne and Grange Road in Cambridge and carry out all associated works.

The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Portmoak, Perth and Kinross) (Emergency) (Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations revoke the statutory instrument which imposed emergency restrictions on flying in the area specified in the Schedule to that instrument, the emergency in question having passed.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Spring Park, Wiltshire) Regulations 2026
summary: The Secretary of State for Transport has decided that it is necessary in the public interest for reasons of national defence to restrict the flying of unmanned aircraft in the vicinity of Corsham, Wiltshire.

title: The Air Quality (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations are made in exercise of the powers under Article 15(1), (2) and (5) of the Environment (Northern Ireland) Order 2002.

title: The Health and Safety (Miscellaneous Repeals, Revocations and Amendments) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under the Health and Safety at Work (Northern Ireland) Order 1978 (“the 1978 Order”) and the Offshore, and Pipelines, Safety (Northern Ireland) Order 1992. They repeal certain provisions of the Factories Act (Northern Ireland) 1965 and the Office and Shop Premises Act (Northern Ireland) 1966. The Regulations also revoke six Instruments. The legislation being removed is either redundant or has been replaced by more recent provisions. The Regulations make minor amendments to five Statutory Rules. These repeals, revocations and amendments were the subject of a public Consultation in accordance with Article 46(3) of the 1978 Order.
